messages:
Maria G: Quick update — we're GAing the new Realtime GraphQL Proxy on Hosted API today at 14:00 PT. This brings first-class streaming + tool-calling over a single GraphQL endpoint. Docs and migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/realtime-graphql :tada:

Kevin L: Awesome! rollout plan? any impact to existing REST users?

Maria G: Rollout: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~6 hours, with live monitoring and automatic rollback on error. Existing REST endpoints continue to work; GraphQL is opt-in. New endpoint: `https://api.redwood.ai/v2/realtime/graphql`

Aj Patel: Auth change? same API keys or new scopes?

Maria G: Same API key. Optional header for realtime mode: `x-rw-runtime: realtime`. Tool-calls require the `tools` scope on API keys — SEs will get an automated permission grant mail for customers who requested early access.

deploy-bot: deploy job #3245 succeeded on prod (us-west-2) — all checks passed 

Kevin L: Nice. Any example for streaming responses?

Maria G: Example curl (SSE chunked streaming):

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"subscription($input: ChatSub!){chat(input:$input){delta}}","variables":{"input":{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q1 OKRs"}]}}}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/realtime/graphql
```

Maria G: For tool-calling: include `tools` list in the GraphQL operation. The runtime will stream partial tool responses as they arrive (see tool-calling section in docs).

Emily R: What about Dedicated / Private customers? auto-migrate?

Maria G: Dedicated: opt-in per tenant today (we won't force-migrate). Private: image + config will be available next week; customers will have to opt into new runtime. We'll send direct comms and package migration playbooks for SEs.

Chris S: Deprecation timeline for old streaming path `/v1/stream`?

Maria G: `/v1/stream` is scheduled for deprecation: 90-day notice starting today, with a compatibility layer available for 6 months. See migration checklist in the guide.

Kevin L: Any perf/latency notes?

Maria G: Early benchmarks: median token latency improved ~12% for short-turn dialogues, tail latency (p95) similar. We'll publish a breakdown in the performance dashboard later today.

Sam (cto): Huge milestone — thanks to runtime, infra, product, and docs teams. Please keep an eye on SLOs and escalate if anything looks off.

Maria G: Will do. Ops will post a status thread if we see any anomalies. For questions, tag @maria.g or the #eng-runtime channel. Huge thanks everyone! :rocket:
